name: @hhcp/db
description: Single source of truth for the HHCP PostgreSQL schema: the numbered .sql migrations (RLS, SECURITY DEFINER functions, partitioning + pg_partman + pg_cron, BRIN, generated tsvector) plus the Python seed/bootstrap scripts. Shared by BOTH backends — neither owns the schema.

scripts.apply: for f in migrations/*.sql; do psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f"; done
